claims: Arizona defeated the LIU Sharks 92-58.
Arizona was the #1 seed.
The LIU Sharks were the #16 seed.
The game was a West Region first-round game in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
The game took place on March 20, 2026.
The game was played at Viejas Arena in San Diego, CA.
Arizona entered the tournament with a 33-2 record.
The LIU Sharks entered the tournament with a 24-11 record.
Brayden Burries scored 18 points for Arizona.
Koa Peat scored 15 points for Arizona.
Ivan Kharchenkov scored 14 points for Arizona.
Ivan Kharchenkov had 10 rebounds for Arizona.
Mason Porter-Brown scored 15 points for LIU.
Greg Gordon scored 12 points for LIU.
Arizona led 53-29 at halftime.
Arizona shot 53.3% from the field.
Arizona shot 46% from 3-point range.
Arizona outrebounded LIU 52-31.
Arizona had 10 blocks.
Arizona outscored LIU 50-26 in the paint.
Arizona won by a 34-point margin.
The 34-point margin was Arizona's largest in an NCAA Tournament game since 1998.
Arizona led by as many as 38 points.
Arizona advanced to the second round.
Arizona will face the winner of Villanova vs. Utah State in the second round.
